routing_risks.detail: shrv1 uses multi-entry HTML plus HashRouter in admin.html; shf-next uses pathname SPA routing. Relative links cannot cross apps reliably without an absolute base URL.
shrv1 Vite commonly runs on 5174 in recent smoke; shf-next can also use Vite defaults/preview. Cross-app links need environment-specific base URLs.
